import pandas as pd
path = '/data/asha_ngo_finances_FY25-26.xlsx'
df = pd.read_excel(path, sheet_name='Transactions')
print(df['Category'].unique())
print(df['Program'].unique())
# Compute total spend
total_spend = df['Amount (INR)'].sum()
print("Total spend:", total_spend)
# Group by Program and Category
grouped = df.groupby(['Program','Category'])['Amount (INR)'].sum().reset_index()
grouped['pct_of_total'] = grouped['Amount (INR)'] / total_spend * 100
grouped['pct_of_total'] = grouped['pct_of_total'].round(1)
print(grouped.sort_values('Amount (INR)', ascending=False))
# Also total by Program
prog_total = df.groupby('Program')['Amount (INR)'].sum().reset_index()
prog_total['pct'] = prog_total['Amount (INR)']/total_spend*100
print(prog_total)
# Total by Category
cat_total = df.groupby('Category')['Amount (INR)'].sum().reset_index()
cat_total['pct'] = cat_total['Amount (INR)']/total_spend*100
print(cat_total)
